stem: Which condition did both slaves and free blacks in the United States experience in the antebellum period?

options.label: F
options.text: Both groups were allowed to testify in court.

options.label: G
options.text: Both groups were able to vote in elections.

options.label: H
options.text: Both groups were forced to pay taxes.

options.label: J
options.text: Both groups were denied citizenship rights.
